messages:
Maria: quick q — i pushed a tiny PR that only reorders imports + runs gofmt (https://git.redwood/pulls/1832). should we accept without touching generated clients? it looks like the generator header moved a line and now CI flags it.

Kai: can you paste the minimal diff for the generated file? we try to avoid hand-editing generated artifacts.

Maria: here — just the top of pkg/gen/client.go: 
```diff
-// Code generated by vendor/tool; DO NOT EDIT.
-import (
-    "fmt"
-)
+// Code generated by vendor/tool; DO NOT EDIT.
+import (
+    "context"
+    "fmt"
+)
```

Oliver: looks like gofmt reordered a single import and the generator stamp stayed same. that should be reverted — generated files must match generator output.

Josh: agree. we should either regenerate with the same tool + gofmt, or revert that file. for style-only PRs i'd prefer excluding generated directories from manual formatting to avoid churn.

Maria: ok i'll drop the generated file from the commit and force-push. keeping the rest (import order + fmt) is small.

Maria: fyi i'll also add a note in the PR description: "format-only, removed accidental gen diff"

Kai: sweet, @Maria ping me after you push and i'll re-review. :+1:

ci-bot: build queued for PR 1832 — linux/go-tests

Maria: pushed the followup (force-pushed: removed pkg/gen/client.go change; updated PR desc).

Kai: quick look — LGTM on the remaining changes. small nit: can you run `gofmt -s` locally and confirm no further diffs?

Maria: ran `gofmt -s` locally, no diffs. added a short changelog line in PR.

Kai: approved.

Kai: @Josh could you add your approval when you have a sec so merge-bot can pick it up in the window?

Josh: gave approval :thumbsup:

ci-bot: build passed for PR 1832 (all checks green)

merge-bot: PR 1832 queued for merge in the 11:00 merge window

Maria: thanks everyone — sorry for the churn, learned to avoid touching generated files in quick style sweeps.

merge-bot: merged PR 1832 by Maria — "format: reorder imports; remove accidental gen file change"

Maria: closing the loop. :tada:
